blends.name: Kuiper Crew Membership License
blends.desc:
Kuiper Crew Membership License

Requires "Proof of Ship": own at least one (1) NFT from the ships schema

https://neftyblocks.com/marketplace/listing?page=1&collection_name=kuiperonenow&schema_name=ships

This license is transferrable until redeemed

**Kuiper Crew Benefits include:**
* Whitelisted for all general drops
* Access to reserved drops and blends
* Access to exclusive Kuiper Crew drops
* Eligible to earn Achievements
* Advanced access to intel
* Access to special giveaways
* Eligible to earn future Badges

**There are two ways to become a Kuiper Crew member (only need to complete one):**
1. Genesis Badge
2. Membership License

**Membership License**
1. Purchase (https://neftyblocks.com/c/kuiperonenow/drops/112789) or blend (https://neftyblocks.com/c/kuiperonenow/blends/blend.nefty/22147) a Member License 

2. Redeem Member License for Kuiper Crew Badge (https://neftyblocks.com/c/kuiperonenow/blends/blend.nefty/6320)

If you already have a Kuiper Crew badge you do not need to purchase this license unless you want to sponsor another crew member, enable another wallet, or otherwise support the project.

Learn more at: https://kuiperone.io/wk2/pmwiki.php?n=Site.KuiperCrew

blends.name: Lore - Kuiper One
blends.desc:
Lore cards tell the story of Kuiper One and the universe around it.

They also explore various theories/conspiracies surrounding its disappearance as well as the impact it had on the economics and politics of the time.

Ship Upgrades include a token to claim a lore card.

To collect all the lore cards, will need to perform every ship upgrade at least once to get a claim token.

Those who collect all the lore cards will be able to unlock the final special edition panels that reveal the conclusion of the mystery.

This lore card can be obtained by upgrading an Enduring to Type 5 Tactical

https://neftyblocks.com/c/kuiperonenow/blends/blend.nefty/20772

blends.name: DGA-9 Tractor Beam
blends.desc:
Basic Directed Gravity Accelerator DGA-9 Scout Class Tractor Beam

Having a common designer, the League of Oracles, the DGA-9 is an advanced version of the tractor beam used in the SOH-B-01. Where the SOH-B-01 design is open source and must be controlled manually, the DGA-9 has an on board AI that can pinpoint and manipulate objects as small as a square inch using directed gravity.

Note that salvaging will require a Kuiper Crew member badge, a Brinehurst ship, an RDS-A1 scanner and a DGA-9 tractor beam.  Salvaging is planned to start before the end of October.

How to join the Kuiper Crew:
https://kuiperone.io/wk2/pmwiki.php?n=Site.KuiperCrew

blends.name: SOH-B-01
blends.desc:
Basic Scout Class Ore Harvesting Turret

Equip to space faring vessels with at least one open turret hardpoint to mine asteroids for ore

The SOH-B-01 design was published as Open Source to the public domain by the League of Oracles and does not require a Schematic to build, making it an economical choice for space adventurers just starting their career.  Lacking advanced integrated computer, it must be manually controlled and is slow and inefficient compared to more advanced harvester turrets.

Learn more at https://kuiperone.io/

Get Connected:  https://linktr.ee/kuiperone
